item.title: New president at the helm at Sotheby’s Canada
item.description: Mustafa Abbasi succeeds Effi Barak, who has served as interim president since April 2025. Barak will step down following the transition.

item.title: AD Mortgage research shows minor FICO improvements can ease homebuying costs
item.description: The AD Mortgage study found that in most states, it takes 1.5 to 3 years to raise an average FICO score to the 760 prime threshold.

item.title: AD Mortgage launches its largest non-QM securitization yet
item.description: AD Mortgage launched its largest RMBS package, a $602.7 million non-QM deal backed by 1,793 loans, nearly all them with fixed rates.

item.title: RealTrends Verified brokerage Rogers Healy and Associates merges with Compass
item.description: Rogers Healy and Associates has merged with Compass, and founder Rogers Healy plans to step back from daily leadership to focus on venture capital.

item.title: Mortgage rates fall to multiyear lows in time for spring housing market
item.description: Mortgage rates fell to 5.98%-5.99% as the 10-year yield moved under 4% and mortgage spreads held near normal levels.

item.title: Capital One joins BPC housing affordability council
item.description: Council members share insights and contribute to policy discussions related to housing supply, affordability and access.

item.title: Tavant agentic AI portal connects lenders, real estate agents, borrowers
item.description: Tavant leaders sat down with HousingWire to detail benefits for mortgage professionals, real estate profesionals, borrowers and all housing stakeholders.

item.title: New Jersey reverse mortgage counseling bill would have ‘chilling effect’ on senior home equity use, NRMLA says
item.description: NRMLA this week sent a letter to a New Jersey lawmaker, stating its opposition to a legislative proposal tied to reverse mortgage counseling requirements in the Garden State.

item.title: loanDepot executive Alex Madonna departs, starts Trust One Financial
item.description: Alex Madonna is departing loanDepot after 16 years and says his new firm, Trust One Financial, will open in early April.
